data.action: 优雅侧身摆出古典细剑击剑架势，身后巨大影蛾金翼展开，剑尖凝聚星烛
data.description: 昏暗沉寂的战场中央，薇薇安娜摆出高雅古典的击剑架势。金色细剑的尖端凝聚起一团璀璨如星辰的烛光，巨大的影蛾光翼在她身后展开，将周围的阴影与黑暗尽数驱散——「即使微光渺小……我也绝不会背弃我的誓言。」
data.lighting: 细剑尖端的一点暖金火星照亮前手与剑格，远处巨大蛾影勾亮断石
data.promptProse: On a ruined field at night, Viviana turns sideways into a fencer's stance and levels her slender rapier, right arm extended and back foot planted among scattered stones. A concentrated golden flame glints at the tip and reflects back along the guard and the engraved trim of her breastplate. Farther back, a giant moth made of light opens its wings above the ruined field. Keep a gap between the moth and her shoulders and leave space in front of the rapier tip so the two sources of light can be read independently.
data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 微光照彻长夜的剑芒
data.animaCaption: Turning into a poised fencing stance among the ruined stones, Viviana levels her slender rapier as a concentrated golden flame gathers at its tip. Behind her in the dark sky, a giant luminous moth spreads golden wings of light above the battlefield.
